privacy.title: Your data (GDPR)
privacy.body: You can download all your data or delete your account at any time. Details:
privacy.deleteWarning: Deleting the account cannot be undone.
privacy.deleteSoloOrg: Organizations where you are the only member are deleted together with the company profile, documents and analyses.
privacy.deleteSharedOrg: In organizations with other members your account is removed and the organization’s data stays.

company.title: Company profile
company.subtitle: We use the profile to calculate how well tenders fit your company (0–100). The more complete the profile, the better the results.
company.emptyTitle: The company profile has not been created yet
company.emptyMember: An organization admin can create the profile.
company.readOnly: Only organization admins can edit the company profile.
company.scopeHint: These fields directly affect the match score.
company.cpvHint: A general code (e.g. 45000000) covers all codes below it. Up to 50 codes.
company.countriesOfInterest: Countries you want to bid in
company.countriesHint: If you select no countries, the country of registration is used.
company.rangeError: The minimum value cannot exceed the maximum.
company.name: Company name
company.websiteError: Enter an address starting with http:// or https://
company.resourcesHint: Equipment, staff and financial capacity – useful when checking the conditions for participation.
company.saved: Saved. Matches are being recalculated in the background.
company.scoreDisclaimer: The match score shows how well a tender fits the profile. It is not a probability of winning.
company.privacy: Only members of your organization can see the profile. It is never shared with other users.
company.referencesHint: Completed contracts. A reference in the same sector (CPV division) raises the score.
company.refCpvHint: One code describing the subject of the reference.
company.certificationsHint: E.g. ISO 9001, ISO 14001, licences and permits.

match.title: Matched tenders
match.subtitle: Open tenders scored against your company profile. Every score comes with its reasons.
match.noProfile: The fit is calculated from your company profile: CPV sectors, countries, contract types, value range and references.
match.empty: Lower the threshold or broaden the profile (e.g. more general CPV codes or more countries).
match.disclaimer: The 0–100 score shows how well a tender fits the company profile. It is not a probability of winning and does not consider competitors.
match.panelHint: Fit with the profile, not a chance of winning

analysis.subtitle: Conditions, criteria, deadlines, guarantees and risks – every point with a quote from the source.
analysis.quota: Analyses this month: {{remaining}} of {{limit}} left ({{plan}} plan)

extraction.NO_TEXT_LAYER: Scan without a text layer – it cannot be quoted, so it is left out of the analysis (OCR coming).
extraction.FAILED: The file could not be read.

analysis.uploadHint: PDF, DOCX, DOC, ODT, RTF, TXT, XLSX, XLS, ODS or ZIP, up to 25 MB. Uploaded files are visible to your organization only.

fetch.FETCHED: Documents fetched from the notice link.
fetch.REQUIRES_LOGIN: The authority’s portal requires signing in or a browser check.
fetch.NOT_ACCESSIBLE: The file could not be fetched from the notice link.

analysis.notConfigured: AI analysis is not configured on this server yet (no Anthropic API key).
analysis.running: Analysis in progress – usually 1–3 minutes. You can stay on the page or come back later.

failed.ai_error: The analysis failed. Try again – it did not use your limit.
failed.ai_rate_limited: The AI service is busy. Try again in a few minutes – it did not use your limit.
failed.ai_auth_failed: The Anthropic API key was rejected. Contact the administrator.
failed.ai_model_unavailable: The configured AI model is unavailable. Contact the administrator.
failed.ai_refused: The model declined to analyse these documents. It did not use your limit.
failed.interrupted: The analysis was interrupted (server restart). Run it again – it did not use your limit.

analysis.stale: The documents changed since the last analysis. Run it again to include them.
analysis.runHint: Documents in the analysis: {{n}}. Analyses of public documents are shared – opening them again does not use your limit.
analysis.quotaUsed: This month’s analysis limit is used up. You can still open finished analyses.
analysis.skipped: Left out because of the request size limit
analysis.truncated: The answer was cut short (length limit). Some sections may be incomplete.
analysis.notFound: No information found in the available documents.
analysis.disclaimer: The AI analysis is an aid and may contain errors. Check every point in the quoted document – the authority’s documents are binding.

fetchReason.INVALID_LINK: The link in the notice is invalid.

fetchReason.UNREACHABLE: The authority’s portal could not be reached.
fetchReason.LOGIN_REQUIRED: The authority’s portal requires signing in.
fetchReason.BROWSER_CHECK: The authority’s portal requires a browser check – such protections are never bypassed.
fetchReason.HTTP_ERROR: The authority’s portal returned an error.
fetchReason.PORTAL_PAGE: The link opens a portal page, not a file.

s1.title: Tell us about your company
s1.subtitle: Three short steps and we will show tenders that fit your business. You can change everything later in the company profile.

s2.title: What do you do?
s2.subtitle: Choose sectors from the CPV vocabulary – the way authorities describe what they buy.
s2.cpvHint: Type a name (e.g. “road works”) or the start of a code (e.g. 45). A general code covers all specific ones.
s2.cpvRequired: Choose at least one sector – without it we cannot calculate the match. You can also skip the setup.

s3.title: Where and how big?
s3.subtitle: Countries you want to bid in and the size of contracts you take on.
s3.valueHint: Values in euro. Leave empty if the value should not affect matching.

done.title: All set!
done.searching: Looking for tenders that fit your company…
done.found: We found {{n}} open tenders that fit your company well.
done.none: No open tenders with a high fit yet. Check back daily – new notices arrive every hour.
done.more: Add references, certifications and resources in the company profile to improve matching.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.subtitle: New matches, changes to watched tenders, deadlines and search alerts in {{org}}.
notifications.emptyHint: Notifications appear when a tender matching your company profile is published, a watched tender changes or its deadline approaches, or a saved search finds new results. New data is checked every few minutes.

settings.intro: These settings apply to you in {{org}}. In-app notifications are under the bell; e-mails go to {{email}}.
settings.unverified: Your e-mail address is not confirmed – notification e-mails are not sent until it is.
settings.searchAlerts: Alerts on new results are set for each saved search separately.
settings.digestNote: Daily digests are sent at 7:00, weekly digests on Mondays at 7:00 (your time zone).

desc.NEW_MATCH: An open tender matching your company profile at least at the chosen level is published.
desc.WATCHED_CHANGED: The deadline, value, documents or status of a watched tender changed, it was cancelled or the award was published.
desc.DEADLINE_APPROACHING: 3 days are left until the submission deadline of a watched tender.

notifications.instantPaid: Instant e-mails are available from the Starter plan.

unsubscribe.title: Unsubscribe from e-mails
unsubscribe.intro: This turns off all notification e-mails (matches, changes, deadlines, search alerts) from this organization. In-app notifications stay.
unsubscribe.done: Done. You will no longer receive notification e-mails from {{org}}.
unsubscribe.doneNoOrg: Done. You will no longer receive these e-mails.
unsubscribe.settings: You can change this any time in the notification settings.
unsubscribe.missing: The unsubscribe link is incomplete. Open it again from the e-mail.

billing.endsOn: The subscription ends on {{date}} – then the Free plan.

billing.noPrice: This billing period is not available.
